title: postapiauthloginwithvalidadmincredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/auth/login with valid admin credentials returns 200 with an authenticated session or JWT, and subsequent GET requests return admin routing context with full access.

title: geteventscopedrecordswithvalideventcontext
description: Verify that GET requests for event-scoped records return only rows for the current event, and POST requests with matching event_id create records successfully, enforcing multi-tenancy and fencing.

title: getapirsvpqueueandclaimgroup
description: Verify that GET /api/rsvp/queue returns prioritized groups needing contact, and POST /api/rsvp/claim_group locks a group exclusively, preventing concurrent claims.

title: getapiroomshotelsandassignments
description: Verify that GET /api/rooms/hotels and /api/rooms/rooms return available inventory, and POST /api/rooms/assignments enforces capacity and prevents overlapping bookings.

title: postapideliveriesanddeliveryproofs
description: Verify that POST /api/deliveries with in-app photo capture creates delivery records, and POST /api/delivery_proofs creates immutable, server-stamped proof records.

title: postapiimportpreviewandcommit
description: Verify that POST /api/import/preview returns a preview of inserts, updates, and skips, and POST /api/import/commit commits the import preserving idempotency via source-row hashes.
